request.acceptance_criteria: In a repository that is not ticfac, on a machine with only the ticfac binaries and node, a local pi-durable run dispatches and completes a worker; no npm install anywhere; doctor checks node; a stale embedded bundle fails the gate; make gate passes
request.description: Today a local pi-durable worker runs node <repo>/harness/src/local/main.ts (internal/exec/subprocess/executor.go harnessDir(), TICFAC_HARNESS_DIR override), so it only works inside the ticfac repository, with harness/node_modules installed. Decision (operator, 2026-10-07): no npm packages — the harness is part of ticfac. Build harness/src/local/main.ts with esbuild (already a dev dependency) into ONE self-contained JS file with pi-durable, pi-ai and chord inlined, as a build step of the Go binary (make build / goreleaser / the image build), and go:embed it. At run time the local executor writes it once to a versioned cache dir (keyed by the build) and runs it with node; the only machine prerequisite is Node, the same Node the claude CLI already needs. TICFAC_HARNESS_DIR still overrides for harness development. ticfac doctor checks node is present and new enough. The embedded bundle must stay in sync with harness/src: a test or the gate rebuilds and compares, so a stale bundle fails CI.
request.title: Ship the local pi harness inside the ticfac binary: one bundled JS file, embedded, run with node
